## 1.

```{r}
set.seed(1)
raw_data_m1 <- simulate_relational_events(
  n_events           = 1000,
  senders            = paste0("a", 1:20),
  receivers          = paste0("a", 1:20),
  baseline_rate      = 1,
  n_controls         = 1,
  endogenous_stats   = "reciprocity_count",
  endogenous_effects = c(reciprocity_count = 0.6)
)
```
